title: The Kites
subject: English
summary: “The Kites” is a poem about the beauty and joy of flying kites. It describes how colourful kites fly high in the sky on a bright and windy day. They dance, twist and turn in the air like birds. The kites look beautiful as they move with the wind. Children enjoy watching and flying them. The poem describes the happiness and excitement of flying kites and enjoying nature. It teaches us to enjoy the simple pleasures of life.
